But semiconductors are getting faster all the time.
for the last 40 years. But at the same time, the cost of that manufacturer has gone

Okay. That makes sense. And so I stand here today looking at Qualcomm's financials
financials and it's $145 billion enterprise value business that fiscal 22 did

At some points in history, if you said that in the wrong bar at the wrong time, you'd get into a fistfight.

I think you had mentioned that effectively every smartphone in the world is on their standard.
Do they license that IP?
Are they producing the chips that go inside the phones?

to upgrade to the latest standard. Historically, what the pattern with Qualcomm has been,
